weapon.d: Effective against beast foes. Grants Spd+3. At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 50%, calculates damage using foe's Res, and inflicts Spd/Res-5 on foe during combat.

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Def.
Boosts damage by 80% of unit's Def.

a.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+3, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+4, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+5, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.

c.d: At start of turn, inflicts Atk-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Def-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Def-4 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
